notesEn.TWN: Dwellings on the property tax register (including vacant ones, fourth quarter of each year) from the Ministry of the Interior's real estate information platform. Taiwan's official statistics classify dwellings only by the number of floors of the building: 4 floors or more count as apartments, 1–3 floors as houses (mostly terraced townhouses). Townhouses with 4–5 floors are also counted as apartments, so the share may be slightly overstated
